messages:
maria: Quick design nit — when streaming the response, VoiceOver reads the token counter before the action buttons. screenshot attached. kevin: Repro'd on mac + VO. Yep that ordering is confusing. We should make actionable controls reachable first so users can interrupt quickly. @sasha any a11y preferences? :thinking_face: sasha: I'd hide the token counter from the accessibility tree (aria-hidden) and expose a separate sr-only live region for streaming updates. Visually keep the token meter, but it should not be tabbable. jon: For keyboard flow we should also move focus to Stop when streaming starts. Flow: Start -> focus on Stop -> user can press Enter to interrupt. Otherwise users tab through a bunch of stuff. maria: Copy question: visible label "Stop" vs "Pause". VO reads "Pause, button" which implies resume. I think "Stop" is clearer. Maybe aria-label="Stop generation" while visible text stays short. kevin: Implementation sketch (will paste in PR): ``` Tokens: 1,234
Streaming — 312 tokens
``` sasha: Small nit: aria-live=polite sometimes gets throttled. Use assertive for the initial "streaming started" and polite for incremental token counts. Also add aria-posinset / aria-setsize for prompt list items in the prompt library. maria: Prompt library ordering: UX wants "Recent" before "Featured" so keyboard users see their saved prompts first. Also add keyboard shortcut to open drawer and focus first prompt. kevin: Will prototype DOM reorder: controls -> content -> token counter (aria-hidden) + sr-only live updates. I'll push branch playground/stream-a11y and ping for review. :rocket: sasha: Happy to review. tiny visual nit — ensure focus ring around Stop matches toolbar spec (2px blue). maria: Thanks y'all — updating figma now and will attach new frames to the thread. planning to land copy + a11y changes in same PR for simpler QA. :thumbsup:
